name: cloud-monitoring-chart-generation
description: >- Generates Google Cloud Monitoring Server-Driven UI (SDUI) Widget and XyChart Protocol Buffer textprotos from resolved PromQL or ListTimeSeries queries. Use when: - Generating valid google.monitoring.dashboard.v1.Widget textprotos, containing PrometheusQuery or TimeSeriesFilter datasets, for use with the Cloud Monitoring Dashboards API, gcloud CLI, or declarative dashboard definitions. - Synthesizing Server-Driven UI (SDUI) widget titles, axis labels, and plot types for Prometheus or ListTimeS
author: google
summary_zh: 把 PromQL 或 ListTimeSeries 查询转成 Google Cloud Monitoring 图表组件配置，适合用 API、gcloud 或声明式文件搭建监控看板。
